name: Dashboard
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built generic 2026-08-24; 13 of 44 local client repos ship a landing dashboard)
description: A dashboard shell a project fills in: registered KPI tiles, an action queue of things needing attention, and a recent-activity feed, all resolved through one batched endpoint. Ships NO charting library — charts go in a named slot so a project picks its own.
